messages.subject: Simulate from Categorical Dist
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to simulate from a categorical distribution from within a SIMULATE block of a TMB model. I attached a MWE of what I had in mind, just modifying the linreg example in the TMB manual. When I test out my rcat function in the SIMULATE block it just returns a vector of 0s. I was hoping someone could help me out, not sure what I'm doing wrong.

Thanks in advance,
Josh

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: Simulate from Categorical Dist
parts:
Your example is mostly correct except for the use of 'runif'. The signature of runif is

template<class Type>
Type runif(Type a, Type b)

It follows that when called with integer inputs (Type=int) the return type will also be int! So, rather than 'runif(0,1)' you could use either

runif(0., 1.)

or

runif(Type(0), Type(1))
